name: adobesign-anvil-migration
description: Migrate existing Adobe Acrobat Sign (Adobe Sign / eSign REST API v6) integrations to Anvil Etch E-Sign. Discovers integration points, maps the OAuth + shard base-URI model to Anvil's single API key, converts library documents to Anvil templates (PDF + Document AI, with a dynamic-doc option), rewrites code, and verifies the migration end-to-end.
